admin.loginLead: Log in with the organizer email and password.

campaign.title: Email campaigns
campaign.lede: Write one message, send it to registered members, ticket buyers, and any extra addresses. Attach photos: they appear in the email.
campaign.name: Internal name
campaign.subject: Subject
campaign.heading: Heading
campaign.peopleHelp: Tick as many people as you want. The boxes above select a whole list at once.
campaign.optedIn: Only members who accepted club emails
campaign.customHelp: One per line, or separated by commas. These are added even if they are not in the club list.
campaign.tokensHelp: Click to insert it into the field you are editing.
campaign.imagesHelp: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF. They are resized, then shown in the email itself. They are not sent as a download.
campaign.sendingConfirm: Send this email to {{count}} people? This cannot be undone.
campaign.createdBody: The draft is ready. Write the message, choose who receives it, then send.
campaign.sentBody: The email is going out to {{count}} person. You can follow the send on this page.
campaign.sentBody_other: The email is going out to {{count}} people. You can follow the send on this page.
campaign.previewSample: This matches the email that will be sent. Switch recipient here only to see the first name. To choose who receives it, tick several people on the left.
campaign.brevoOff: Brevo is not configured on the API. Campaigns cannot be sent until BREVO_API_KEY and BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL are set.
campaign.deleteConfirm: Delete this campaign? This cannot be undone.
campaign.noRecipients: Pick at least one audience or add custom emails.
campaign.badAttachment: This file could not be used.
campaign.badImage: This file could not be used. Try a smaller JPEG or PNG.
campaign.documentsHelp: PDF up to 3 MB. Sent as an email attachment (not shown in the message body).

pwa.installText: Add email campaigns to your home screen to open them like an app.
pwa.installIos: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

errors.apiDown: The API is not reachable. Restart the backend server, then try again.
errors.locked: This campaign can no longer be edited.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sends. Try again in a moment.
